notes.title: Updates in v0.9.1.1 including hotfix
notes.notes:
- Critical problem(could not continue from stage 6) fixed.
- Adjusted difficulty level(on going)
- Added various time of day for each stages
- Now enemy speaks 7 different lines when they're spawned. this might please you.
- Player's location in worldmap is saved. you can continue from last position in worldmap.
